title: The method-of-lines check of the slab disagrees when it should
note: ML1-ML6: the second independent check of the slab (a vertex-centred finite-difference grid integrated by BDF). Each mutation weakens the comparison, the check's own answer or its boundary closure; each must be killed by a test that compares with a wrong solver or with the exact series.

mutations.name: ML1_ratio_ignored
mutations.rationale: a check that never measures the disagreement passes every solver

mutations.name: ML2_coarse_answer
mutations.rationale: the coarse answer with the fine answer's error estimate: the defect this check was written with and its own test caught

mutations.name: ML3_own_error_dropped
mutations.find: r_check = abs(tc - tf) / 3.0       # the error of tf, not of tc
mutations.rationale: an inflated own-error estimate widens the tolerance until a wrong solver passes

mutations.name: ML4_insulated_ghost
mutations.rationale: a leaky insulated face: the check solves another problem

mutations.name: ML5_convective_ghost
mutations.replace: main[-1] = -2.0 * a - a * dx * h / k
mutations.rationale: half the film coefficient at the convective face
